nodes.title: Modular building assembly (read me first)
widgets_values:
Modular buildings: first build a kit (each piece 4 m wide, one storey 3.5 m tall), then place the kit by rules onto every building's facades - the deliverable is **the kit meshes + an instance table**, not a lump of merged buildings.

Kit (the four left columns): Wall_Plain / Wall_Window / Wall_WindowPair / Wall_Door / Wall_Shopfront / Wall_Balcony / Corner_Pillar / Roof_Cornice / Roof_Flat / Roof_Unit / Roof_Tank. Convention: pivot at the midpoint of the bottom edge (rooftop plant: on the roof surface), outer facade facing +Z, wall thickness towards −Z; each piece's primitives have a material attribute (M_Wall / M_Trim / M_Glass / M_Door / M_Metal / M_Roof / M_RoofFlat / M_Sign), exported as glTF material slots; the facade column of the table swaps M_Wall for M_BrickBuff or M_Stucco per building (a material override); UVs are a world-scale box projection (1 UV = 1 m), the same density as the material library (pcg_prod_material_library, one image = 1 m); all seven slots point to the material library's images by relative path in the glb - run the material library first and the kit opens textured.

Assembly (right side):
① On a 4 m grid, rules mark out the footprints of 12 buildings in the four quarters of two crossing 16 m streets (L shapes, slabs, a 14-storey tower, small houses), merged into outlines, each with its own number of floors.
② The outlines are extruded floor by floor, each side face is a 4 m × 3.5 m slot; slot centre → point (with outward normal).
③ Rules: street-facing ground floor is shopfronts, other ground floors occasionally get doors; upper floors take a random number per "column" (the same column lines up vertically), even floors on the street side get random balconies, a few are solid walls; a ring of cornice above the top floor, roofs tiled per cell; pillars stand at the outer wall corners (sharp edges of the extruded mass).
④ Instance table (CSV, with bld / floor / facade columns) + one glb per kit piece (SM_Kit_*.glb).
⑤ Preview (right column): Copy to Points by name places the kit back; the streets get asphalt, sidewalks, road paint, lamps, trees and parked cars; low-detail context blocks (extruded footprints with a whole-bay facade texture) fill the distance; two Camera nodes give a low aerial and an eye-level shot in the Outdoor look (sun, sky, haze).

nodes.title: World-scale box projection (1 UV = 1 m, same density as the material library)
Export: one glb per kit piece (textures point to the material library)
Rules: which cells belong to which building, how many floors
Extrude to the max floor count, one division per floor
Mark what exceeds the floor count

widgets_values:
fl = floor(@P.y / 3.5)
i@floor = fl
@P.y = fl * 3.5                      # pivot at the midpoint of the bottom edge
t = normalize(cross(set(0, 1, 0), @N))
col = floor(dot(@P, t) / 4 + 0.5)    # which column on the facade (aligned vertically)
face = floor(dot(@N, set(1.3, 0, 2.9)) * 10 + 0.5)
h = rand(col * 7.31 + @bld * 13.7 + face * 0.37)
ox = @P.x + 2 * @N.x                 # 2 m in front of the facade
oz = @P.z + 2 * @N.z
street = (abs(ox) < 8) | (abs(oz) < 8)   # facing one of the two streets
win = where(@facade == 2, "Wall_WindowPair", "Wall_Window")   # render facades: paired windows
up_ = where(street & (h > 0.55) & (fl % 2 == 0), "Wall_Balcony",
            where(h < 0.12, "Wall_Plain", win))
ground = where(street, "Wall_Shopfront", where(h > 0.78, "Wall_Door", "Wall_Plain"))
s@name = where(fl == 0, ground, up_)
@up = set(0, 1, 0)
nodes.title: Rules: which piece goes in each slot
→ Rooftop plant (some roof cells)
Keep the cells that got plant

widgets_values:
# the table's asset column is exactly the kit's exported file name (SM_Kit_Wall_Window.glb without the extension)
s@asset = sprintf("SM_Kit_%s", @name)
nodes.title: Asset name = glb file name
Copy to Points (pick piece by name)

widgets_values:
w = @material == "M_Wall"
m = where(w & (@facade == 1), "M_BrickBuff",
          where(w & (@facade == 2), "M_Stucco", @material))
s@material = m
@Cd = where(m == "M_BrickBuff", set(0.70, 0.62, 0.46), where(m == "M_Stucco", set(0.84, 0.77, 0.63), @Cd))
nodes.title: Facade variant → wall material
Cluster sizes + greens
Face the road; lamp / tree alternating; trees vary
Cars: which slots, heading, paint
Park trees: size, turn

widgets_values:
x = @P.x
z = @P.z
inside = (abs(x) < 66) & (abs(z) < 58)
street = (abs(x) < 20) | (abs(z) < 20)
i@drop = inside | street
d = sqrt(x * x + z * z)
# low around the plot so the hero buildings read, taller toward the horizon
f = floor(3 + 4 * rand(@primnum * 1.37) + 7 * smoothstep(110, 280, d) * rand(@primnum * 2.9))
@h = f * 3.5
i@far = where(rand(@primnum * 4.4) < 0.5, 0, 1)
